def tiles(nodes):
    out={}
    for n in nodes:
        if n['pixels']==4 and n['color'] in ('w','g','S','b','p','Y'):
            r=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; c=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            out[(min(r),min(c))]=n['color']
    return out
tb = tiles(previous_frame.segmentation['nodes'])
res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':26,'col':14}])
ta = tiles(current_frame.segmentation['nodes'])
moved = {k:(tb.get(k),ta.get(k)) for k in set(tb)|set(ta) if tb.get(k)!=ta.get(k)}
print('changed:', len(moved))
for k in sorted(moved): print(k, moved[k][0],'->',moved[k][1])
print({k:res.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','level_completed','done','game_over')})
</parameter>
</function>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def tiles(nodes):
    out={}
    for n in nodes:
        if n['pixels']==4 and n['color'] in ('w','g','S','b','p','Y'):
            r=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; c=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            out[(min(r),min(c))]=n['color']
    return out
tb = tiles(previous_frame.segmentation['nodes'])
res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':26,'col':14}])
ta = tiles(current_frame.segmentation['nodes'])
moved = {k:(tb.get(k),ta.get(k)) for k in set(tb)|set(ta) if tb.get(k)!=ta.get(k)}
print('changed:', len(moved))
for k in sorted(moved): print(k, moved[k][0],'->',moved[k][1])
print({k:res.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','level_completed','done','game_over')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
